title: Frappe Framework before 15.120.1 and 16.x before 16.33.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in file attachment…
description: Frappe Framework versions before 15.120.1 and 16.x before 16.33.1 have a path traversal vulnerability in their file attachment handling. This flaw allows authenticated users with minimal privileges to read arbitrary files on the server outside the intended application boundaries. The vulnerability does not require write permissions and can lead to exposure of sensitive server files.
